issues: Dialog overlay lingers with pointer-events blocking after closing via Escape in some flows; consider ensuring DialogOverlay is fully removed on close so subsequent nav clicks aren't intercepted (only affects rapid programmatic navigation; user close via X works fine).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:312 still uses asyncio.gather over 3 LLM agents; it works ONLY because agents.py wraps every send_message in a global asyncio.Semaphore(1). This is fine but non-obvious — add a code comment referencing LLM_SEM, or serialize wave1 with a for-loop for clarity.
server.py is 755 lines and mixes auth/documents/orchestrator/damage/generator/vault/casefiles/lawyers — should be split into routers for maintainability.
server.py:707 list_lawyers uses variable name 'l' (ambiguous single-letter) inside async for loop — minor lint issue.
GET /api/casefiles for role='lawyer' or 'admin' returns ALL casefiles from all users (q={}); if multi-tenant separation ever matters, filter by lawyer network scope.
PATCH /api/casefiles/{id} requires role in ('lawyer','admin') — an owner (regular user) cannot edit their own draft note post-submission; acceptable per HITL design.
server.py:71 cookies use samesite='none' + secure=True — correct for HTTPS preview; will not work over http.
docgen.build_casefile_pdf output verified as valid PDF (%PDF magic, >500 bytes); PDF/A compliance claim is not verified programmatically.
